Pesticides: myclobutanil was quantified in 22 fluids (up to 28.3 micrograms per gram), the pesticide synergist piperonyl butoxide in 18 (up to 24.1), and several other fungicides, insecticides and acaricides above 1 microgram per gram in 25; 31 of the 36 cannabinoid-containing fluids held at least one (editors' count). The authors judge the pattern intermittent and random, and say it would suggest that EVALI is not due to exposure to a single pesticide. No mycotoxins (below 4.8 ng/g) and no synthetic cannabinoids or opioids (below 0.05% by mass) in any fluid.

Aerosol from counterfeit cartridges, collected in one-litre bottles and sent to a commercial laboratory, held over 50 listed volatile compounds (Table 2 has 53 entries), seven of them on the FDA list of tobacco-smoke constituents; silicon, copper, nickel and lead were among the most abundant elements in the liquid, up to 600 parts per million. Vapor-phase and metals results are shown for counterfeit cartridges only.
